_doc: The shared catalog. A game lays its own data/items.json over this one (see README): drop rules, bag sizes, its own bases, and changes or removals by id. Only bases, affixes and uniques whose stats the game implements ever roll there.
_baseFalloff: Within a slot, a base this many levels below the item level drops half as often as one at it: new tiers take over, old ones linger.
_bases: 'props' are the baseline every item of the base carries, rolled in its fixed range: a better tier is better before any affix. 'level' is the item level a base starts dropping at. 'stat'/'at1'/'atMax' (or 'value') is an implicit, which grows with item level unless given as 'value'. Weapons: a starter is handed out, never dropped; the old level-scaled weapons keep their ids and implicits as tiers. Retired bases are the pre-tier armour, kept so saved items load.
_affixes: A 'local' affix multiplies its own item's base property of that stat (+40% armour on a helm) and rolls only on bases that have it; any other adds its stat to the wearer.
